page: Gatwick Airport to Bank EC3R Taxi – LTR Minicab

faqs.question: What is the fixed fare for a taxi from Gatwick Airport to Bank EC3R?
faqs.answer: The fixed fare for a saloon transfer from Gatwick Airport to Bank EC3R starts from £90 — confirmed at the point of booking and unchanged regardless of traffic on the day. If you are travelling as a group or have extra luggage you can select an estate, MPV, or executive car and see the full price before committing. No surcharges, no meter, and nothing added at the end of the journey.

faqs.question: How long is the drive from Gatwick Airport to Bank EC3R?
faqs.answer: The Gatwick to Bank EC3R taxi journey takes between 45 and 60 minutes under normal conditions — travelling northbound via the A23 through Purley, Streatham, Brixton, and Borough before entering the City at London Bridge and continuing to Bank junction, covering around 28 miles. Early morning arrivals before 7am regularly complete the run in under 50 minutes. During the morning rush between 7am and 9am the approach from Borough into the City can add 10 to 15 minutes.

faqs.question: Is a pre-booked minicab to Bank EC3R quicker than taking the train from Gatwick?
faqs.answer: By train, the quickest Gatwick to Bank EC3R route involves the Gatwick Express to Victoria — around 30 minutes — followed by a Circle or District line connection eastbound to Monument, adding another 25 to 35 minutes including platform waiting time and the walk between interchange. With airport luggage across a busy Victoria interchange the total journey regularly runs to 70 to 90 minutes. A pre-booked minicab takes 45 to 60 minutes door-to-door with no changes, no stairs with bags, and a driver waiting in arrivals.

faqs.question: Where does the driver meet me at Gatwick for a Bank EC3R transfer?
faqs.answer: Your driver waits inside the International Arrivals Hall — at whichever terminal matches your flight, North or South. They hold a name board showing your name clearly so you can spot them immediately after clearing customs. This is included as standard on every Gatwick arrivals booking at no extra charge, and your driver's contact number is in the booking confirmation.

faqs.question: What happens if my Gatwick flight is delayed before my Bank EC3R transfer?
faqs.answer: Your driver tracks your inbound flight from takeoff at the origin airport — so any delay is picked up early and the Gatwick pickup time is adjusted accordingly. There is no need to call ahead to report a late arrival. Every Gatwick arrivals booking includes 45 minutes of complimentary waiting time so slow immigration, long baggage waits, or customs delays are all covered without any extra charge.

faqs.question: Can I arrange a cab from Bank EC3R to Gatwick Airport?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — the return journey from Bank EC3R to Gatwick runs at a fixed fare from £97 for a saloon, confirmed upfront before your driver is dispatched. For early morning Gatwick departures from the City the A23 southbound through Brixton and Streatham is typically clear before 6am. Book at least 24 hours ahead to secure your preferred vehicle, and allow 90 minutes or more from Bank EC3R to your Gatwick check-in desk during peak travel periods.

faqs.question: Which car should I choose for a group travelling from Gatwick to Bank EC3R?
faqs.answer: Up to four passengers with standard luggage are well catered for by the saloon or estate. Groups of five or six will be more comfortable in the MPV 5 or MPV 6, both of which offer generous boot space. Larger delegations of seven or eight can opt for the MPV 7, the Executive MPV 7 in a Mercedes V Class for a premium arrival into Bank, or the MPV 8 — all bookable at a fixed pre-agreed fare.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book a Gatwick pickup for Bank EC3R?
faqs.answer: Booking 24 to 48 hours before your Gatwick arrival is generally sufficient for most vehicle types and times of day. For early morning Bank EC3R departures to Gatwick — particularly anything before 6am — placing the booking the day before ensures your chosen vehicle is confirmed. For larger vehicles such as the Executive MPV 7 or MPV 8, booking 48 hours ahead is advisable during busy periods.

faqs.question: Are the drivers on the Gatwick to Bank EC3R route licensed by Transport for London?
faqs.answer: Yes — every driver covering the Gatwick to Bank EC3R route holds a current Transport for London private hire licence, meaning they have been vetted, background-checked, and are lawfully authorised to carry passengers for hire across the capital and the surrounding counties. All vehicles are maintained and insured to private hire standards for the complete journey.

faqs.question: Does my driver know Bank EC3R's access restrictions and drop-off points?
faqs.answer: Yes — Bank junction and the surrounding EC3R streets carry some of the City of London's tighter access restrictions, with certain roads pedestrianised or closed to through traffic at various times of day. LTR Minicab drivers covering this route are familiar with these conditions and will route to the correct entrance of your specific hotel, serviced apartment, or office address. If you have specific access requirements, you can include those details in the booking notes when you reserve.
